Hi everyone! I've just opened my first Mathlib PR: #36091

It formalizes Eidelheit's separation theorem (geometric_hahn_banach_of_interior_nonempty) and cleans up the longstanding TODO block at the top of Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.Separation.

A few implementation details I wanted to highlight for reviewers:

  • I added a B.Nonempty assumption. Without this, if B is empty and A spans the whole space, the only bounding continuous linear functional would be f = 0. Adding this guarantees we avoid that triviality trap and get a genuinely non-zero functional.
  • To keep the API symmetrical with the rest of the file, I normalized the real-valued theorem to use StrongDual ℝ E instead of E →L[ℝ] ℝ, and added the corresponding RCLike analogue.
  • The second TODO regarding interior (closure s) ⊆ s is also removed. Instead of proving it from scratch, I used Convex.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior to extend the weak inequality from interior A to all of A.

Big thanks to Kenny Lau for pointing me toward the right convex topology lemmas in an earlier thread!

CI is fully green. I'd really appreciate it if someone could take a look!
Addressed wwylele’s comments and CI is green again.
